tests.title: Register User Positive Test
tests.preconditions: No user exists with given username
steps: User enters valid username, email, and password
tests.expected_result: User is successfully registered and logged in

tests.title: Invalid Login Negative Test
tests.preconditions: User has not registered or logged in
steps: User enters invalid username and password
tests.expected_result: System displays an error message indicating invalid credentials

tests.title: Browse Products Positive Test
steps: User navigates to the product catalog
tests.expected_result: User sees a list of available products with details and images

tests.title: Search Products Positive Test
tests.expected_result: System displays a list of matching products with details and images

tests.requirement: Search returns empty result for invalid query
tests.title: Invalid Search Negative Test
tests.expected_result: System displays an error message indicating no matching products found

tests.title: View Product Details Positive Test
steps: User views the product details page
tests.expected_result: User sees detailed information about the selected product

tests.requirement: User can add product to cart
tests.title: Add Product to Cart Positive Test
tests.preconditions: Product exists in catalog and user has a valid account
steps: User clicks the 'Add to Cart' button
tests.expected_result: Product is successfully added to the user's cart

tests.title: Update Cart Quantity Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart

tests.requirement: User can remove product from cart
tests.title: Remove Product from Cart Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart
tests.expected_result: Product is successfully removed from the user's cart

tests.title: Proceed to Checkout Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart and a valid account
tests.expected_result: System redirects user to the checkout process

tests.title: Shipping Address Validation Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart and a valid account
tests.expected_result: System validates the shipping address successfully

tests.title: Payment Processing Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart and a valid account

tests.title: Order Confirmation Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has products in their cart and a valid account
steps: System displays the order confirmation page

tests.title: Order History View Positive Test
tests.preconditions: User has placed orders in the past
steps: System displays a list of previous orders
tests.expected_result: System displays a list of previous orders successfully
